items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: So I was the only one in the band... No, Peanuts was there, too.

ctx.x: No, wasn't no problems with the people in the band. Charlie wouldn't go for that shit. If you was prejudiced, you didn't have no business being there, and he let you know that right away.

But there were a few occasions where an incident come up... Like, the road manager wouldn't put my name down on the thing for a reservation for a room or something in White hotels in the... We went to Worcester. Now, you know Worcester is not a real prejudiced place. But he didn't put the names down. So when I went to go check in, I heard someone say, "Well, give him a key for Howard McGhee." And he says, "No, no-no, we don't have no Howard McGhee on here." So I was the only one in the band... No, Peanuts was…
